# Description

https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/pull/3655 recently fixed failures in the distributed cross entropy tests. However, https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/pull/3671 did not incorporate the fix (setting device ID when initializing NCCL) and it caused the failure to reappear.

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation change (change only to the documentation, either a fix or a new content)
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Infra/Build change
- [ ] Code refactoring

## Changes

- Set device ID in distributed cross entropy + argmax test
